text: `CLOUD_PROBE_MS = 120000`, hidden tabs skip the probe entirely, returning to the tab probes immediately, and a 15 s tick drains queued work early (issuing no request at all when nothing is pending). The probe was confirmed to be a pure connectivity/sync heartbeat — it never repaints `day_status` into the UI — so slowing it down cannot make the cashier's view stale.
